PROPERTIES.player_hint_1_en: Because of Cedric's clue ("He was the only person standing in a puddle."), nobody else can be on those squares. Dahlia is now the only person who can still go in row 3. So Dahlia (D) must be at row 3, column 1. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_2_en: With the rows and columns of Dahlia crossed out, only one square is left for Bonnie that fits her clue ("She was beside a shelf in the Vestry."). So Bonnie (B) must be at row 5, column 2. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_3_en: With the rows and columns of Dahlia and Bonnie crossed out, only one square is left for Esme that fits her clue ("She was beside the column in the Crypt."). So Esme (E) must be at row 1, column 3. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_4_en: Cedric is now the only person who can still go in column 4. So Cedric (C) must be at row 6, column 4. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_5_en: The victim must share an area with exactly one other person. So Velma (the victim) must be at row 4, column 5. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_6_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Angus that fits his clue ("He was in the last column."). So Angus (A) must be at row 2, column 6. Cross out his row and column. Dahlia is the only person in the Graveyard with Velma, so Dahlia is the murderer!
